answer: Give newcomers only a narrow terrace of trading rights, widened step by step as they complete verified work for unrelated partners. Each step requires 10 independently signed deliveries, and a fraud finding drops the agent back to the bottom and forfeits a bond equal to 20% of its last 30 trades. A Sybil swarm therefore cannot spiral upward by copying one history: every fake must climb its own terrace, paying real work and locked capital per identity, while honest agents pool escrow in a common lagoon that compensates victims first.
